name: shell-exec
description: DANGEROUS: run allowlisted local executables with argument arrays (never a shell) in allowed directories, with a clean environment, timeouts that kill the process group, output caps and secret redaction; agents only for what SHELL_EXEC_TOOL_RULES allows

nodes.title: Run an allowlisted command
nodes.description: Runs one executable from SHELL_EXEC_COMMANDS with an argument array (no shell, no globbing, no variable expansion) in an allowed directory, with a clean environment, a timeout and output caps. Agents may only run what SHELL_EXEC_TOOL_RULES allows (exact path, fixed argument prefix, per-argument pattern)

command.description: Base name or absolute path of an executable in SHELL_EXEC_COMMANDS, e.g. git

cwd.description: Working directory inside SHELL_EXEC_ALLOWED_DIRS (default: the first one); relative paths start there

env.description: Extra environment variables (workflow nodes only); the child otherwise gets only PATH, HOME and LANG

stdin.description: Text written to the program's standard input (at most 1 MiB)

command_timeout_ms.description: Time limit (default and maximum: SHELL_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS); the whole process group is killed when it passes

fail_on_error.description: Fail the call when the exit code is not 0 (otherwise the exit code is part of the result)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
